notes.title: V0.2.0 Update
notes.content:
[h3]Dear players, this update will bring new characters, levels and multiplayer online functions! Update the game to experience it. The following are the details
[/h3]

[h2]New content[/h2]
[h3]1. New character [Female Taoist][/h3]

The default spell is [Peach Wood Sword]: Swing the peach wood sword to emit sword energy, which can penetrate all enemies
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44968408/a25120982b6acc65d07fa163b700296841df118e.gif[/img]
[h3]2. New level [Gobi][/h3]

Contains 5 new enemies: worms, hellhounds, self-destructing bees , Fireball Monster, Little Mage, Pig King
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44968408/2c0c39ea9be7df15b1a1135d3914ed6dce43a6ed.gif[/img]
[h3]3. Multiplayer Online Mode[/h3]
Supports 2 players to challenge, welcome all players to experience
New online mechanism: Soul Return Curse
Teammates will turn into [Soul] and continue to fight after falling to the ground
[Soul] can provide [Concentration] buff to teammates within 10 meters (spell damage +50%, spell cooldown -30%)
Every time a surviving teammate kills an enemy, 10 points of "Soul Fire" can be condensed for the [Soul], and when 100 points are collected, the [Soul Return Curse] can be activated to revive.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44968408/090931af1f407fd234ab018fd01fe8df9d646fe2.gif[/img]
[h2]Optimization/Adjustment[/h2]
The basic damage bonus of the original character [Male Taoist] has been changed to 120% to distinguish it from the new character [Female Taoist];

[h2]BUG Repair[/h2]
Fixed several bugs
